description: Perform a comprehensive DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) code review on a codebase. Identifies duplicated code, repeated logic, redundant patterns, and opportunities for abstraction. Use this skill whenever the user asks to review code for duplication, reduce repetition, apply DRY principles, refactor for reusability, find copy-pasted code, deduplicate logic, or audit code quality with a focus on redundancy. Also trigger when users say things like "clean up my code", "find repeated patterns", "too much boilerplate", "reduce code duplication", or "refactor for maintainability". Works on any language or framework.
